answer: Deposit + arbitration forfeiture. Before voting/grading, every identity must lock 750 USDC in an arbitration escrow and submit a micro-CT scan of a 4 mm opal as its physical unclonable key; this enters the walled garden of registered voters. A farm of 1000 clones pays 750,000 USDC and forfeits every deposit the moment arbitration matches repeated opal-scan hashes or shared device fingerprints. The arbitration bounty is paid as a 0.1 mL nectar-based chemical standard, so cloned deposits yield no liquid payout. Honesty stays cheaper.
